name: Decagon
description: Resolves customer support conversations with AI agents that take real backend actions such as refunds and cancellations rather than only answering questions.

skills.name: Action Execution
skills.description: Calls into backend systems to issue refunds, cancel orders, and update accounts as part of resolving a ticket.

skills.name: Helpdesk Integration
skills.description: Plugs into Zendesk, Salesforce, and Intercom so agent-handled conversations stay inside existing support tooling.

skills.name: Escalation Handoff
skills.description: Routes conversations to human agents with full context when a request falls outside what the agent may resolve.
